topic: How multi-factor authentication stops most account takeovers, and why phishing-resistant passkeys go further

request.audience: all employees, non-technical, in a corporate security awareness programme
request.notes: Rebuild of mfa-explained after the requester's review (projects/mfa-explained/REVIEW_2026-10-06.md). One story, two people: an employee and an invented thief at another desk. Real-looking login screens and a phone, large in frame. The four ideas as four turns of the same story. At most four templates. Light, warm, readable; type large.
